Digested sol ids are further conditioned and dewatered using a centrifuge or belt filter presses.
Dewatered solids are h auled off -site by a private contractor and routinely recycled on agricultural lands as a source of nutrients and soil amendment.
In an emergency, solids can be used as daily cover for solid waste at a landfill.
